deviations.what: On b1.7.3-stationapi the redstone engine's item is unshaded in the GUI slot, and a flat-lit block item is unshaded in the player's hand (mods/coverage/tests/coverage_flat_hand-Test.grug, since the loader draws the hand), which their own captures prove, but no test draws it in third person or on the ground, so whether those drawings are unshaded like 2.2.14's is unverified. The plate sits at the reference's progress 0.25 everywhere.
deviations.why: StationAPI accumulates a baked item model's quads and flushes them after the model draw returns, where fixed-function lighting is applied, so the reference's rule has to wrap that flush. The mixin that does it is applied on all three paths, but third person needs a second entity holding the item and a camera on it, and a dropped item rotates as it ages, so the ground one is not reproducible.

deviations.what: The redstone engine's particles are verified by count and position against 2.2.14's BlockEngine, which the test reads from what the display tick spawned, but no capture compares the drawn particles with the reference's.
deviations.why: The screenshot runs drop particles (minimal setting, or the spawn skipped under GRUG_CI on Alpha and Beta), a particle's constructor draws random numbers a test cannot seed, and the reference run cannot record its spawns.
